# Actions reference

Intelligent mode changes a survey only through ACTIONS: a closed vocabulary of operations the engine validates and applies to a copy of the definition before anything is shown for approval. A sentence the engine reads becomes actions; a language model's answer is actions too, in the same vocabulary, through the same gate. Every action names its objects by question code (`Q7`), variable name (`AGE`), option code or label, block title or batch ref (`ref` on a `create_*` action, usable by later actions in the same batch). Conditions (`CondInput`) are the text logic language or a JSON `Condition`.

## The operations

**Survey** (29): `create_block`, `rename_block`, `delete_block`, `create_question`, `update_question`, `delete_question`, `move_question`, `set_display_logic`, `add_skip`, `clear_skips`, `set_validation`, `page_break`, `create_embedded`, `create_calculation`, `create_randomizer`, `create_branch`, `create_loop`, `set_research`, `add_punch`, `remove_punches`, `create_qual_guide`, `update_qual_guide`, `configure_ai_interviews`, `connect_panel`, `disconnect_panel`, `configure_alerts`, `set_answer_key`, `clear_answer_key`, `set_assessment`

**Options and design** (18): `update_option`, `reorder_options`, `set_option_randomization`, `set_mask`, `clear_mask`, `duplicate_question`, `set_survey_settings`, `update_embedded`, `remove_embedded`, `add_hypothesis`, `remove_hypothesis`, `set_hypothesis`, `set_custom_code`, `set_question_media`, `create_logic_script`, `update_logic_script`, `remove_logic_script`, `set_logic_script_enabled`

**Look and behaviour (UX)** (13): `create_style`, `update_style`, `remove_style`, `create_animation`, `update_animation`, `remove_animation`, `create_behavior`, `update_behavior`, `remove_behavior`, `set_theme`, `set_custom_html`, `set_default_value`, `set_navigation`

**Analysis** (12): `set_question_analysis`, `propose_analysis_plan`, `set_analysis_plan`, `add_crosstab`, `remove_crosstab`, `add_analysis_test`, `remove_analysis_test`, `add_derived_variable`, `remove_derived_variable`, `update_crosstab`, `update_analysis_test`, `reorder_analysis_plan`

**Localization** (9): `add_language`, `remove_language`, `set_language_status`, `set_translations`, `approve_translations`, `confirm_translations`, `set_language_routing`, `set_glossary`, `replace_wording`

**Quotas** (6): `create_quota`, `update_quota`, `add_quota_cells`, `remove_quota_cells`, `delete_quota`, `set_quota_check`

**List Fill** (3): `create_list_fill`, `update_list_fill`, `remove_list_fill`

**Research methods (MaxDiff, conjoint)** (5): `create_maxdiff`, `update_maxdiff`, `create_conjoint`, `update_conjoint`, `simulate_conjoint`

**Qualitative (AI follow-up probes)** (1): `set_probe`

## Survey actions

From `packages/engine/src/surveyActions.ts`:

```ts
export type SurveyAction =
  | { op: "create_block"; ref?: string; title: string; after?: string }
  | { op: "rename_block"; target: string; title: string }
  | { op: "delete_block"; target: string }
  | { op: "create_question"; ref?: string; block?: string; after?: string; /** placed just before this question (durable tasks: a planned question restored to its slot) */ before?: string; newPage?: boolean; type: string; text: string; code?: string; variable?: string; options?: OptionSpec[]; rows?: string[]; scale?: ScaleSpec; required?: boolean; randomize?: boolean; instruction?: string; validation?: ValidationSpec[]; /** what an "Other (specify)" box accepts (QT-08) */ otherFormat?: OtherFormat; /** what the answer is — age, year, count, percent, currency, email, phone, postal, url — or "none" to keep the registry out */ semantic?: Semantic | "none"; /** S2b: the variant's own settings, as update_question */ settings?: Record<string, unknown> }
  | { op: "update_question"; target: string; text?: string; type?: string; code?: string; variable?: string; required?: boolean; instruction?: string; options?: OptionSpec[]; addOptions?: OptionSpec[]; removeOptions?: (string | number)[]; rows?: string[]; scale?: ScaleSpec; randomize?: boolean; otherFormat?: OtherFormat | "none";
      /** `settings.hidden` — hidden from respondents on the live link, shown (purple, with its auto-punch result) in preview and test (2026-10-24) */
      hidden?: boolean;
      /** the request also asked for Read Only, which is no longer a question state (2026-10-24): applied as nothing, and said so */
      readOnlyIgnored?: boolean;
      /** S2a D16: a variant's own settings (e.g. gamified.timed timeLimitSeconds / onTimeout) — only the keys the variant declares, each checked against the question schema */
      settings?: Record<string, unknown> }
  | { op: "delete_question"; target: string }
  | { op: "move_question"; target: string; block?: string; after?: string; before?: string }
  | { op: "set_display_logic"; target: string; expression: CondInput | null }
  | { op: "add_skip"; from: string; when: CondInput; to: string }
  | { op: "clear_skips"; target: string }
  | { op: "set_validation"; target: string; rules: ValidationSpec[] }
  | { op: "page_break"; after: string; remove?: boolean }
  | { op: "create_embedded"; name: string; source?: "url" | "static" | "panel" | "expression"; value?: string }
  | { op: "create_calculation"; name: string; expression: string; label?: string; dataType?: "numeric" | "text" | "boolean" }
  | { op: "create_randomizer"; blocks: string[]; show?: number; title?: string }
  | { op: "create_branch"; blocks: string[]; when: CondInput; title?: string; arms?: { blocks: string[]; when: CondInput; label?: string }[]; otherwise?: string[] }
  | { op: "create_loop"; from: string; to: string; over?: string; items?: string[]; loopVar?: string; title?: string }
  | { op: "set_research"; strict?: boolean; objective?: string; hypotheses?: string[]; population?: string; sampleSize?: number; methodology?: string; constructs?: { name: string; role?: string; definition?: string; questions?: string[] }[]; analysis?: string[]; assumptions?: string[]; sources?: string[];
      /** Phase 3: the questions the research answers, the KPIs it reports, who it is written for */
      researchQuestions?: string[]; kpis?: { name: string; variable?: string; measure?: string; target?: string; direction?: "higher" | "lower" }[]; audience?: { description: string; characteristics?: string[]; literacy?: "plain" | "general" | "expert"; tone?: string; language?: string } ; /** Phase 8: the project brief — merged into the one recorded, field by field */ brief?: { client?: string; businessQuestion?: string; decision?: string; background?: string; stakeholders?: string[]; deadline?: string; deliverables?: string[] } }
  /* criteria-based coding (punching): IF <when> THEN code <target> — on the target question's punch rules */
  | { op: "add_punch"; target: string; when?: CondInput; action?: "select" | "deselect" | "set_value" | "clear"; codes?: (string | number)[]; value?: string | number; expression?: string; label?: string; mode?: "if" | "else_if" | "else"; recompute?: "once" | "always" }
  | { op: "remove_punches"; target: string; id?: string }
  /* the survey's look and behaviour — see uxActions.ts; they write def.ux and nothing else */
  | UxAction
  /* the analysis framework — see analysisActions.ts; they write question.analysis and research.analysisPlan and nothing else */
  | AnalysisAction
  /* languages, translations, glossary and language routing — see localizationActions.ts; they write def.localization and nothing else */
  | LocalizationAction
  | QuotaAction
  /* List Fills — see listFillActions.ts; they write def.listFills and the destinations' masks */
  | ListFillAction
  /* MaxDiff and conjoint as research designs — see methodActions.ts; they write def.designs and the question that renders the design */
  | MethodAction
  /* options one at a time, masks, duplication, survey settings, embedded fields, hypotheses, custom code — see optionActions.ts */
  | OptionAction
```

Supporting types:

```ts
export type OptionSpec = string | { label: string; code?: string | number; exclusive?: boolean; other?: boolean; anchor?: boolean };
export interface ScaleSpec { points: number; start?: number; low?: string; high?: string; mid?: string; labels?: string[] }
export interface ValidationSpec {
  kind: string;
  value?: number | string;
  /** the rule applies only while this holds (any nesting) */
  when?: CondInput;
  /** kind "condition": what a valid answer must satisfy (stored negated: the engine's `check` is the invalid case) */
  check?: CondInput;
  message?: string;
  /** S2a D16: "warning" shows the message and lets the respondent continue (schema ValidationRule.severity); absent = a blocking error */
  severity?: "warning";
}
```

```ts
export type OptionAction =

  | { op: "set_option_randomization"; target: string; enabled: boolean; anchors?: OptionRef[]; keepLast?: OptionRef[]; keepFirst?: OptionRef[]; pick?: number; scope?: MaskDimension; /** S2a D16: how — shuffle (default), rotate (each item in each position equally often: "equally", "balanced"), reverse_half */ method?: "shuffle" | "rotate" | "reverse_half" }
  | { op: "set_mask"; target: string; expression: string; action?: OptionMask["action"]; dimension?: MaskDimension }
```

```ts
  | { op: "update_analysis_test"; id: string; method?: AnalysisMethod; outcome?: string | null; variables?: string[]; groupBy?: string | null; moderator?: string | null; mediator?: string | null; priority?: number; hypotheses?: string[]; reason?: string | null; /** merged into the item's options; a key set to null is removed */ options?: Record<string, unknown> | null }
  /** the ids in the order wanted; an id left out keeps its relative place after the ones named */
```

```ts
  | { op: "set_glossary"; entries?: { source: string; targets?: Record<string, string>; doNotTranslate?: boolean; notes?: string }[]; remove?: string[] }
  /*
   * 2026-10-25 (translation tasks): REPLACE THE SOURCE WORDING in place, element by element ("make this survey
   * Urdu", not "add an Urdu version"). The one localization action that writes outside `def.localization`: only
   * the text field each element key names (setSourceText); codes, logic, piping and scripts are untouched, and
   * the same checks as set_translations apply (pipes / placeholders / HTML / script of `language`). With
   * `sourceLanguage: true` (a whole survey replaced) the survey's source language becomes `language`.
   */
  | { op: "replace_wording"; entries: TranslationSpec[]; language?: string; sourceLanguage?: boolean };
```

```ts
export interface MethodPlacement {
  ref?: string; block?: string; after?: string; newPage?: boolean; code?: string;
  /** question text; a neutral default for the method when absent */
  text?: string; required?: boolean;
}
export interface MaxDiffSpec {
  items?: string[];
  /** take the items from this question's options (or a grid's rows); None / Other excluded */
  itemsFrom?: string;
  addItems?: string[]; removeItems?: string[];
  perTask?: number; tasks?: number | null; appearances?: number | null; versions?: number;
  responseMode?: "best_worst" | "best_only";
  anchored?: boolean; anchorPrompt?: string | null;
  prohibitedPairs?: MaxDiffPair[]; addProhibitedPairs?: MaxDiffPair[]; removeProhibitedPairs?: MaxDiffPair[];
  bestLabel?: string | null; worstLabel?: string | null; instructions?: string | null;
  practice?: boolean; itemsPerVersion?: number | null; balance?: "optimized" | "greedy";
  seed?: number; name?: string;
}
export interface ConjointSpec {
  method?: ConjointMethodName;
  attributes?: { name: string; levels: string[] }[];
  addAttributes?: { name: string; levels: string[] }[];
  removeAttributes?: string[];
  /** replaces the levels of the named attributes */
  levels?: Record<string, string[]>;
  alternatives?: number; tasks?: number | null; versions?: number; holdouts?: number;
  none?: boolean; noneLabel?: string | null;
  prohibitions?: ConjointProhibitionInput[]; addProhibitions?: ConjointProhibitionInput[]; removeProhibitions?: ConjointProhibitionInput[];
  design?: "efficient" | "balanced";
  /* menu-based */
  items?: MenuItemInput[]; requiredItems?: string[]; minSelections?: number; maxSelections?: number; currency?: string;
  /* adaptive (ACBC) */
  screeningTasks?: number; conceptsPerScreen?: number; tournamentAlternatives?: number; maxAttributesVaried?: number; minTournamentConcepts?: number;
  /* F4 2026-10-22 — ACBC summed price: base + per-level increments ({"Brand":[0,50,120]}), ± variation % */
  priceBase?: number | null; priceIncrements?: Record<string, number[]> | null; priceVariation?: number; priceCurrency?: string;
  /* F4 2026-10-22 — CBC dual-response None, alternative-specific / labelled designs */
  dualResponse?: boolean; dualResponsePrompt?: string | null;
  labelled?: boolean; brandAttribute?: string | null; alternativeSpecific?: { attribute: string; appliesTo: string[] }[] | null;
  /* F4 2026-10-22 — menu: mutually exclusive sections */
  exclusiveGroups?: { name: string; items: string[] }[] | null;
  /* F4 2026-10-22 — rating-based (CVA) */
  mode?: "single" | "paired"; profiles?: number | null; scaleMin?: number | null; scaleMax?: number | null; minLabel?: string | null; maxLabel?: string | null; monotone?: Record<string, "increasing" | "decreasing"> | null;
  seed?: number; name?: string;
}
```
